title: Review what Celerp AI wants to change
summary: Celerp AI proposes each change as a card you confirm or dismiss; nothing is written until you confirm it.

steps.text: Before the assistant changes anything in your books, it shows the change as a card naming what it wants to create or update.

Confirm applies the change and links to the record it created or updated; Dismiss discards the proposal and nothing is written. Several proposals from the same answer can be confirmed together with one Confirm all.
A proposal that failed can be retried from the same card; one still waiting on something else shows why, so you know what to do next.
